# Issue 2502 captures

The three `.txt` files reproduce the ANSI-stripped pane excerpts published in
https://github.com/asheshgoplani/agent-deck/issues/2502, fetched 2026-10-04.
The issue lists nine affected captures but supplies pane excerpts for only
pair-006, pair-066, and pair-088. The other six have not been reconstructed.

Source environment reported by the issue: Claude Code 2.1.287, Haiku 4.5,
agent-deck 1.16.24-era source. The relevant shape is a live asterisk spinner
immediately above a framed empty composer, sometimes separated by a Tip line.
Tests outside these files explicitly label additional adversarial cases as
synthetic. These files are inert text; never execute their displayed prompts.
